profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Background: Was born in Mexico in extreme financial poverty. Moved to
New Mexico/US at 7 years old with my family, not knowing any English. Grew up in rural New Mexico(Lake Arthur) on the farm, worked in manual labor/agriculture during my youth. Would work 10-12-hour days during the summer. Married for 10 years – 3 kids.

Hobbies: Mountain Trail Running, Weightlifting, Exercise, Reading Books, Building Personal Library, Mechanical Engine Fixing, Leadership, Motivation, Business.

Life Vision Statement: To be the best version of myself and thereby inspire and lead others
towards achieving the best version of themselves and achieve measurable results in all areas of life.

Future:
Technical: Machine Learning, Scikit Learn- Tensor Flow, Python, Natural Language Processing.

Leadership: 360 Degree Leader, Art of Significance, Looking for New ways to motivate people, psychology, etc. Personal: PRs in trail running, family, weight lifting, reading, spirituality, constantly working on new areas.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Business Knowledge(Areas of Expertise): International Exports, Logistics(Domestic U.S based and International), Warehousing and Distribution, Human Resources, Protein Industry, Oil and Gas, USDA FSIS. 

SAP Solutions: GTS, HR, CRM, ECC,FIORI, JCO Connector, SD

SAP Specific: SAP ABAP,SAP ABAP WebDynpro, SAP Web UI, SAP Adobe Interactive & Non Interactive PDF forms, ADOBE ADS Server, SAP Security, RFC , IDOC, EDI  

SAP Development Tools: SAP ABAP Workbench, SAP UI Component Workbench, Configuration, Adobe LiveCycle(used for building SAP based PDF forms).

SAP Training: SDLC, SAP BC400 & BC401, WUS581, SAPX05 SAPUI5 User Experience Development

SAP Areas of Interest(Areas I am interested in working on): GTS, TM, HANA, Mobility

Non SAP
Languages: JAVA, C++, ColdFusion 9, VB.NET, JSP, Javascript, HTML

Tools: BMC Remedy, HP Quality Center, Netbeans IDE, ColdFusion Builder

Query Languages: SQL, OPEN SQL

Databases: Oracle, SQL Server, SAP HANA(Limited)

Operating Systems: Windows 7, UNIX, AIX, Open VMS

Web Servers: Glassfish, Microsoft IIS, Apache

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical Software Lead and Application Architect for the customer facing components of GMs Online Service Scheduling Ecosystem.

Duties Include: 
- Setting technical direction for our solution as well as implementing new solutions within the ecosystem.
-Technologies include: Azure Cloud, Azure Gateway/WAF, ReactJS, MicroFront End, SpringBoot,JAVA, PCF, Akamai, etc.
- Experience standing up large browser based applications from scratch using ReactJS frontends with Java Backends.

positions.title: Sr. Development Lead
positions.description:
Projects/Responsibilities:

ReactJS Development Lead - End to End knowledge of the technical development of a ReactJS based application from scratch and deploying it successfully to production 0 to 1. ReactJS, Redux, SAGA, Axios, Babel, WebPack, NPM, etc.

FIORI (FIORI Launchpad, FIORI UI5 APP Development) - End To End Knowledge of FIORI Solutions including FIORI 2.0

- Primary Technical Architect for the FIORI launchpad and one of the primary technical resources on the FIORI T&E project. 

-SAP UI5 Lead Developer of both fully custom apps, and the extension of the FIORI standard apps. 

-FIORI Gateway Anti Virus Configuration/Development/Support

FIORI Mobile Solutions

- Constructed/Designed/Developed/Led Mobile specific solutions for GM FIORI solutions. 

- Developed/Architected WAG Solutions to allow the running of FIORI applications on Mobile/Tablet devices outside of the internal network. (SS0, SAML, ALIASES) 

- Performed mobile issue resolution with great success via mobile debugging/configuration on GM FIORI solutions. 

FIORI SAP Classes Attended:
- SAPX03       SAP Fiori Implementation, Administration
- SAPX04       HTML5 Foundations for SAP SAPUI5 Development
- SAPX05       SAPUI5 User Experience Development
- SAPHA450 UI5 Application Development for SAP HANA

SAP AP
-Responsible for designing and building multiple AP components related to inbound invoice document processing. 

-Lead performance improvement efforts on the technical AP module side, pioneered the use of parallel processing in order to improve performance on the project. 

SAP AP/ Open Text VIM/ Invoice Vendor Portal
- Primary designer and architect for the technical integration on the SAP/ABAP side for Inbound Invoices via the Vendor Portal into SAP Open Text VIM and then onto SAP AP. 

- Took over Open Text VIM technical solution after vendor resources rolled off the project. 

- Primary contact for integration of Open Text VIM/ SAP AP ABAP to SAP workflow on the SAP ABAP side.

positions.title: SAP Developer
positions.description:
Member of the Summit SAP ABAP Development team, duties include:

Primary technical developer for the SAP CRM implemtation/project. 
- Enhance CRM GENIL&BOL components as required.
- Create ABAP based interfaces for importing and exporting data out of CRM.
- Modify/Create BADIs as required to enhance standard CRM.
- Perform heavy customization to the WEB UI as required.
- Create custom RFCs to communicate data between CRM and ECC.   

Assist in program creation/modification as required in Summit's SAP Systems.
- Work with MM module to improve ABAP based processes for inventory. 
- Enhance and create needed ABAP processes to enhance communication between 
  SAP systems(RFCs, etc.)

positions.title: SAP Technical Analyst
positions.description:
As a Member of the Phillips 66 SAP HR Technical Team, I was tasked with the below:

- Modify and enhance ABAP/Web Dynpro based applications for Payroll. 

- Support and enhance a JAVA/SAP Manager Self Service application based within SAP Portal. 

- Support and enhance an HR DATA Warehouse which consisted of data extracted out of the SAP   HR system. 

- Coordinate technical side of SAP HR Team efforts related to SAP Security. 

- Create and enhance Unix Scripts to connect SAP systems to non SAP systems, assist in developing a secure solution to transferring data across landscapes. 

*Great place to work, Phillips 66 is an excellent employer!*

positions.title: SAP Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
- Primarily tasked with developing and supporting applications for the Warehousing and Logistics.

- Worked primarily as an SAP ABAP developer for 3 years, in the SAP environment.

- Emphasis on developing SAP ABAP RFCs to communicate across SAP landscape as well as integrating SAP GTS with legacy systems as well as using Adobe LiveCycle to create SAP based PDF forms.

- Developed a JAVA PDF document merging system to be used for USDA export documents within SAP GTS. 

- Performed redesign and modifications to multiple C++ based interfaces, which are used to communicate across legacy systems.

- Good business knowledge of exporting product out internationally and integrating said business processes into GTS.  

- High exposure to the SDLC with an emphasis on requirements gathering.

positions.title: GS7 Technical Analyst(While Attending University)
positions.locationName: Las Cruces, New Mexico, United States
positions.description:
- Primarily tasked with integrating a SQL Server based backend with a ColdFusion based frontend for a BLM pilot IS system as well as creating the frontend system. 

- Also tasked with developing standards for future data entered into pilot database as well as analyzing tables for data normalization.

positions.title: Product Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed SQL Server automated scripts to populate development databases with accurate example data.

- Worked on product development team conducting defect resolution within ARGO base products, work involved fixing defects in Javascript, HTML, ASP, and XML.

honors.title: Enterprise SAP Build Team Energy Award
honors.description: Received 4 separate energy awards for great work during the 1st quarter of 2016.
